utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox and a couple spare clamps, and last I heard we still needed duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — duct tape and gloves are already handled, so your toolbox and clamps help. I’m still sorting tools and pickups if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll bring the toolbox and clamps then, and if you find any gaps with tools or pickups just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I lock anything in, can you confirm the latest sign-up count and which houses still need fixes for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, Hana — I want to confirm the latest list with Rosa first, along with the drop-off window and whether tool intake or setup still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — please check the latest sign-up count too, and let me know which houses still need fixes before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, Rosa’s still pulling the list together, and I’m asking around this afternoon so I can send her any volunteers or repair needs I find. I’d wait to count anyone in for sure until she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That makes sense—I’m still in, and I’ll keep gathering names and repair needs to pass to Rosa without promising anything’s covered until she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That lines up with what I’ve heard—thanks, Mara. Once Rosa confirms the list, we’ll have a better sense of who’s solid and what still needs tools or hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, slowly. I think we’re still short on a few basics, but the extra hands are helping.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which basics are still short, exactly, and who’s actually confirmed to cover them so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only know for sure we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, and Noah’s the one who mentioned those. I’m sorry—I don’t have a clean list beyond that yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, we’re still on for 10, and I’m trying to get everything sorted before you get here.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—10 still works for me as long as we keep it moving so I can make school pickup on time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—I’ll keep it tight and make sure we start right at 10 so you can get out for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, I’ve got Maple noted with 12, 18, and 27 already on the repair drive list, and Rosa’s sending the full rundown this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, Opal—thank you. I’m still hearing around 10 for the repair drive overall, and I think duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are the main things we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m marking duct tape and two pairs of work gloves as the immediate gaps, and I’ll keep Maple at 12, 18, and 27 until Rosa’s full list comes in this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ira, keep it simple: it’s a repair drive, folks can bring things that need fixing, and we still need duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli—that helps. I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted if anyone picks up the duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Ira—I’ll stick to that simple update and let you know as soon as someone claims the duct tape and the two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, screws are sorted and Uli can bring some tools later, but we’re still short on duct tape and two pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m coming in late, Tess—want me to go grab the duct tape and two pairs of work gloves first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Dane, that’d be a huge help—yes, if you can grab the duct tape and two pairs of work gloves, that should cover the main gaps folks keep asking about.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help once the list is clear—do we know yet which houses still need fixes and whether anyone’s taken the lamp rewiring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still confirming which houses are on the list, and I don’t have anyone firmly on lamp rewiring yet. Supply-wise, we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—once you’ve got the houses confirmed, point me where I’m needed; and if no one takes lamp rewiring, I can at least help if someone shows me what to do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’ve got screws covered already, and I’m telling folks we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks, Vik—I’d nearly bring the screws anyway. As far as I remember, I’m still on the folding tables, and lamp rewiring still needs someone too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll keep telling folks screws are covered, we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, and that folding tables are on you while lamp rewiring still needs someone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Outreach’s already moving, so start with supplies and who’s still missing tools—lamp rewiring still needs someone, and I’m waiting on the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it—I’ll start on supplies and check who’s still missing tools, and I can also help find someone for lamp rewiring once that list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—do that, and if you find someone for the lamp or spot any tool gaps, just shoot me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Kira, I’m spreading the word that it’s a repair drive where folks can bring things that need fixing, and we still need duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm who’s actually committed to help and whether those tools and supplies are definitely covered?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: So far Sam’s committed to help and said they’ll spread the word too, but duct tape and the two pairs of work gloves still aren’t covered yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can still bring my toolbox and a couple of spare clamps, and last I heard we were short on duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—are you definitely confirmed for Sunday, and who’s actually covering the duct tape and work gloves right now?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m confirmed for Sunday, but I haven’t heard anyone specifically claim the duct tape or gloves yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it—I’ll start by lining up volunteers for the porch steps on Maple and the garden-lot fence, then send Rosa the order and supply list before we spread the word any wider.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Mara—that’s the right order. Once Rosa has the list, let’s check what’s still missing before we ask around any wider.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—I’ll get Rosa the volunteer and supply list for the porch steps and garden-lot fence first, then I’ll circle back with you on what’s still missing before we widen outreach.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, I’m spreading the word that it’s a repair drive where folks can bring things to fix, and I’m also telling everyone we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds right, but I’d still like the organizers to confirm the latest sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and the drop-off window before we promise too much.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good call—I’ll tell folks it’s a repair drive and we still need duct tape and two pairs of gloves, but I’ll hold off on the sign-up count, houses, and drop-off window until the organizers confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Jules, quick version: Saturday at the church lot, and I’m bringing a drill, extension cord, and spare screws—if you’ve got the latest repair list, send it over so I can sort who needs tools versus fixes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — latest I’ve got is around 10 people, and I think we still need duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves. I’ll keep sorting folks by tools versus fixes and send any changes along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—bring me the skim version if the list shifts; I’ve got the drill, cord, and screws, and I’ll see if someone can cover duct tape and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s go one at a time—lamp rewiring first, and if you can, mark down duct tape and two pairs of work gloves as still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—lamp rewiring is still unclaimed, and I’ve written down duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves under supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. If anyone asks where to help next, point them at the lamp rewiring first—that’s the gap I’m most worried about.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Nell, I’m on the folding tables, and unless someone stepped up, the lamp rewiring still needs a volunteer. I’m also meant to bring Uli those spare screws this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve been hearing second-hand—lamp rewiring still sounds open, but Rosa should confirm before we count on anything. And yeah, definitely get those spare screws to Uli this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks—I'll take the screws to Uli this afternoon, and I’ll check with Rosa before I tell anyone the lamp rewiring’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hana, can you confirm whether Sam or Tess has the latest on the volunteer list, the houses needing fixes, and what tools are actually on hand, or is it all still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s still being firmed up from my side—I can’t confirm whether Sam or Tess has the latest until I check who’s actually committed, which houses still need fixes, and what tools are on hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, so it’s still up in the air then—can you check with Sam or Tess and confirm who’s committed, which houses are first, and what tools are definitely on hand?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep—I've got screws covered already; for the repair drive, we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—duct tape and two pairs of work gloves are still open; where are you keeping the box list so I can note the pickup spots too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the box list with me—note duct tape for the tools box and the two pairs of work gloves with the safety gear, and I’ll keep the screws marked covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort tools and do pickups; what still needs covering for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo—that helps a lot. Outreach and recruiting a couple more bike or small-appliance folks still need covering, unless you want me to handle supplies first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can spread the word and try to find a couple more bike or small-appliance folks. Supplies should be covered already.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Ira, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m still confirming who’s fully committed and which tools are definitely covered. Right now we still need someone for lamp rewiring, plus duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know, Rosa—I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted on who commits and whether you get the lamp rewiring, duct tape, and gloves covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Ira—I’ll send you the confirmed list once I’ve locked down the volunteers and tools, and I’ll especially update you on the lamp rewiring, duct tape, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I lock anything in, can you confirm the current sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and what tools we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the sign-up count or a full list of houses confirmed yet, but screws are covered and Uli said he can bring some tools later. What I do know for sure is we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ll hold off on locking anything in until we have the sign-up count and the confirmed house list, but I’ve noted that we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Dane—start with the parts list, and I’ll bring the toolbox and clamps over so we can move straight into the first fixes once we’ve got the volunteer list nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Gus—I’ll start on the parts list now; who’s still waiting on confirmed needs so I can plug the gaps first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Kira was still waiting on the confirmed volunteer list and which houses are definitely first, so plug those gaps first; we also still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So right now it’s the folding tables on you, and lamp rewiring still doesn’t have a confirmed person—did I get that right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right—and I think duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves are still unassigned too, unless someone grabbed those while I lost track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, so folding tables are on you, and lamp rewiring, duct tape, and work gloves still need a confirmed person—has anyone definitely claimed any of those, or are they all still open?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, screws are covered, and Uli may bring tools later, but I’m still only marking supplies and volunteers as tentative until they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—can you send the confirmed drop-off window and which tool volunteers are definite once you lock them in, so we don’t send people over too early?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll send the confirmed drop-off window and only the definite tool volunteers once they’re locked in, so the details stay clear and no one shows up early.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, how’s the repair drive shaping up? I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted on what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quietly coming together—tables are covered, screws are getting to Uli this afternoon, and lamp rewiring still needs a volunteer. If you want, I can keep the list simple and tell you what supplies are still short when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps, thanks—keep the list simple for me, and let me know if the lamp rewiring gets a volunteer before I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right now I’m treating tools as unconfirmed until the organizer says so, and on supplies we still need duct tape and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve been hearing second-hand too—tools still sound unconfirmed, and I’d rather check with Rosa before anyone counts on them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Exactly—I’ll keep tools marked as unconfirmed for now, and the definite gaps are still duct tape and work gloves until someone claims them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Noah, quick version: I’m still waiting on the latest repair list, but I’m sorting who’s bringing tools versus who needs fixes as soon as it lands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re still aiming for around 10, and duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are the main things still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, keep those on the needed list for now, and if you hear who’s confirmed for 10, send me the names so I can slot tools against repairs fast.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Eli, I’m keeping the locations straight—Maple already has 12, 18, and 27 on the repair drive list, so I’m watching for any gaps on the rest of the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s helpful, Opal—let’s keep the list tidy and note any missing houses, and for the repair drive the clear message is that folks can bring things that need fixing while we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve noted the message and the supply gap, and I’ll keep checking Maple for any missing houses beyond 12, 18, and 27.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and should I start with outreach or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can still do 10 if we keep it pretty tight around school pickup and drop-off. Have you heard anything more from the organizer about whether outreach or supplies is the bigger gap?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard an update yet, but the last I knew the bigger gaps were outreach and finding a couple more bike or small-appliance folks. If you can do 10, I’m happy to start spreading the word and checking who’s confirmed for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So far I’m definitely in, and Noah’s not fully confirmed yet—he’s still thinking around 10. If you can ask around for duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you confirm who besides you is actually committed and whether the tools are definitely covered before I start asking around?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right now I can only firmly confirm me; Noah’s still a maybe for 10, and I’m still checking on the rest. Tools aren’t fully covered yet, so if you can ask around for duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara—I’ll keep spreading the word and send any more names or repair needs your way so Rosa gets the full list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll add that you’re spreading the word and lining up more helpers, and I’ll pass along anything else you send so Rosa has the full list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll keep canvassing the block and send over any new names, helpers, or repair needs as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo, we’re doing a repair drive soon, and I’m telling folks screws are covered but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Those are covered now too. I can help sort tools or do pickups if anything else is still open.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Leo—I’ll tell folks the duct tape and gloves are covered now, and that you can help sort tools or do pickups if anything else comes up.
